purpose: Plan connected Harbor workflows, decompose their required analytical operations, and vary their scientific context while retaining executable rewards.

workflows.name: Data preparation
workflows.outcome: Prepare measurements and identities for a specified downstream analysis.

workflows.name: Exploratory data analysis
workflows.outcome: Characterize patterns, groups or representations in observations.

workflows.name: Association analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate or test an association on correctly matched observations with the stated unit of replication.

workflows.name: Regression modeling
workflows.outcome: Fit a specified response model and report parameters, uncertainty or fit diagnostics.

workflows.name: Group comparison
workflows.outcome: Estimate or test a group contrast with explicit sampling, pairing and effect direction.

workflows.name: Multiple-testing correction
workflows.outcome: Correct a declared family of hypothesis tests and retain its tested population.

workflows.name: Differential expression analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate expression contrasts under an explicit design, measurement model and gene-selection rule.

workflows.name: Enrichment analysis
workflows.outcome: Quantify gene-set, pathway or feature overrepresentation relative to a declared universe.

workflows.name: Sensitivity analysis
workflows.outcome: Repeat an analysis under controlled changes and quantify the resulting differences.

workflows.name: Predictive modeling
workflows.outcome: Build and apply a predictor to unseen observations under the required split policy.

workflows.name: Model evaluation
workflows.outcome: Evaluate complete predictions with a fixed metric and biological grouping or split policy.

workflows.name: Survival analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate time-to-event quantities using explicit censoring, risk sets and covariates.

workflows.name: Causal inference
workflows.outcome: Estimate a specified causal contrast under explicit identification and sensitivity assumptions.

workflows.name: Sequence alignment
workflows.outcome: Align sequences or reads and interpret correspondence, scores and coordinate conventions.

workflows.name: Sequence and annotation analysis
workflows.outcome: Extract or reconcile sequences with strand, coordinate, translation and annotation rules.

workflows.name: Genomic interval analysis
workflows.outcome: Compute coordinate-aware overlap, distance, coverage or interval transformations.

workflows.name: Sequencing quality and coverage analysis
workflows.outcome: Measure read, alignment and reference coverage with explicit eligibility and denominators.

workflows.name: Sequence assembly and assessment
workflows.outcome: Assemble or assess contigs using observed read support, continuity and error evidence.

workflows.name: Variant analysis
workflows.outcome: Call, normalize, filter or summarize variants with explicit allele and sample semantics.

workflows.name: Variant consequence annotation
workflows.outcome: Connect alleles to transcript, protein or regulatory consequences under pinned references.

workflows.name: Population genetic analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate allele-frequency, ancestry, differentiation or inheritance quantities.

workflows.name: Orthology assessment
workflows.outcome: Assess homologous gene identity, completeness and copy status across proteomes.

workflows.name: Phylogenetic inference and tree analysis
workflows.outcome: Infer or measure trees with explicit topology, branch-length, rooting and taxon conventions.

workflows.name: Alignment informativeness and composition
workflows.outcome: Measure informative sites and sequence composition under explicit gap and residue rules.

workflows.name: Cell identity annotation
workflows.outcome: Assign or compare cell identities against declared reference evidence and an abstention policy.

workflows.name: Population composition analysis
workflows.outcome: Compare population counts and fractions while preserving sample-level denominators and replication.

workflows.name: Data integration
workflows.outcome: Reconcile batches, studies or modalities and evaluate alignment without erasing the target variation.

workflows.name: Mixture deconvolution
workflows.outcome: Estimate component abundances or signals using declared references and identifiable mixtures.

workflows.name: Trajectory and dynamics analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate ordered states or dynamics and distinguish model-derived order from measured time.

workflows.name: Cell communication analysis
workflows.outcome: Compute expression-supported ligand–receptor or sender–receiver evidence under a frozen reference.

workflows.name: Spatial analysis
workflows.outcome: Quantify spatial relationships, neighborhoods or gradients with explicit geometry and null models.

workflows.name: Chromatin accessibility and binding analysis
workflows.outcome: Analyze accessibility or binding signals using controls, replicates and reference-aware regions.

workflows.name: Motif analysis
workflows.outcome: Find or assess sequence motifs under explicit models and background composition.

workflows.name: Methylation analysis
workflows.outcome: Quantify methylation at sites or regions with coverage, measurement-unit and reference rules.

workflows.name: Network analysis
workflows.outcome: Construct or evaluate typed networks, modules, paths or connectivity with traceable edges.

workflows.name: Molecular structure analysis
workflows.outcome: Measure structural geometry, residue/atom identity, contacts or structural agreement.

workflows.name: Molecular representation and descriptors
workflows.outcome: Parse chemical structures and compute graph, charge, stereochemical or descriptor properties.

workflows.name: RNA structure analysis
workflows.outcome: Predict or compare RNA structure under declared thermodynamic or measured constraints.

workflows.name: Image measurement and reconstruction
workflows.outcome: Measure or reconstruct image content with explicit calibration, pixel geometry and sample identity.

workflows.name: Signal and time-series analysis
workflows.outcome: Process recorded signals or time series with explicit sampling, filtering and temporal splits.

workflows.name: Dose–response and assay analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate assay responses and control-adjusted effects with declared plate, dose and replicate structure.

workflows.name: Differential abundance analysis
workflows.outcome: Estimate abundance contrasts under measurement, missingness and replicate conventions.

workflows.name: Immune repertoire analysis
workflows.outcome: Reconcile receptor chains and quantify clonotypes, diversity or sharing across samples.

workflows.name: Biological database querying
workflows.outcome: Resolve identifiers and retrieve versioned records under explicit query and evidence rules.

workflows.name: Structured evidence extraction
workflows.outcome: Extract specified facts or measurements with source locations, units and a finite evidence scope.

workflows.name: Evidence-based prioritization
workflows.outcome: Rank candidates under declared evidence, eligibility and tie rules without asserting unmeasured causality.

workflows.name: Mechanistic modeling
workflows.outcome: Construct a mechanistic representation, optionally selecting experiments to constrain it.

workflows.name: Sequence construct analysis and design
workflows.outcome: Construct or audit sequence products against explicit compatibility, translation and assembly constraints.

workflows.name: Descriptive analysis
workflows.outcome: Summarize a biological measurement or compare descriptive endpoints.

workflows.name: Taxonomic profiling
workflows.outcome: Assign sequence evidence to taxa and quantify their abundance under a pinned reference and ambiguity policy.

workflows.name: Expression quantification
workflows.outcome: Estimate transcript or gene abundance from reads with explicit reference, multimapping and normalization rules.

workflows.name: Cell and feature quality control
workflows.outcome: Select cells or features using declared measurement-aware quality, contamination and doublet rules.

workflows.name: Model inspection
workflows.outcome: Inspect architecture, parameter identity or uncertainty from an executable model and pinned checkpoint.

workflows.name: Image segmentation
workflows.outcome: Assign pixel or voxel masks to structures under a specified label and geometry convention.

workflows.name: Image object detection
workflows.outcome: Localize and label objects using boxes, points or equivalent spatial annotations.

workflows.name: Molecular structure prediction
workflows.outcome: Generate molecular conformations or binding poses with valid atom identity and geometry.

workflows.name: Chemical structure recognition
workflows.outcome: Convert a chemical drawing to a machine-readable molecular structure.

operations.name: Normalization
operations.outcome: Adjust measurement scale or composition using a declared normalization procedure.
operations.include: Rescale counts, library sizes or measurement distributions as a required operation.
operations.exclude: Reading normalized inputs; logarithms alone; normalization internal to a method without a separate required result.

operations.name: Data transformation
operations.outcome: Apply a defined mathematical transformation while preserving identities, missingness and units.
operations.include: Apply an explicitly requested mathematical change of variables.
operations.exclude: Already transformed inputs; generic format conversion; incidental transformations internal to another skill.

operations.name: Dimensionality reduction
operations.outcome: Construct a reduced representation and check its fit, variance or neighborhood properties.
operations.include: Compute or assess a low-dimensional representation or its variance.
operations.exclude: Using a supplied embedding; merely drawing coordinates; interpreting a plot without computing an embedding.

operations.name: Feature selection
operations.outcome: Select informative features under a declared criterion without leaking evaluation data.

operations.name: Multiple-testing correction
operations.outcome: Correct a declared family of hypothesis tests and retain its tested population.
operations.include: Choose, apply or audit a multiple-testing procedure as an explicit analysis requirement.
operations.exclude: Counting an already thresholded gene list; an internal default adjustment with no independent requirement.

operations.name: Sensitivity analysis
operations.outcome: Repeat an analysis under controlled changes and quantify the resulting differences.

operations.name: Clustering
operations.outcome: Partition observations and assess grouping stability, separation or external agreement.

operations.name: Predictive classification
operations.outcome: Predict labels or probabilities for withheld observations with a prespecified metric.
operations.include: Produce discrete labels or class probabilities for new observations.
operations.exclude: Selecting a multiple-choice answer; retrieving known labels; specialized cell annotation without a separate generic classification task.

operations.name: Predictive regression
operations.outcome: Predict continuous outcomes for withheld observations under the required split and leakage policy.
operations.include: Predict continuous scalar or vector measurements for unseen observations under an explicit split policy.
operations.exclude: Fitting coefficients for inference; generating molecular geometry; spatial pattern scoring without a supervised prediction requirement.

operations.name: Model evaluation
operations.outcome: Compute or compare model fit, predictive performance or calibration under an explicit criterion and sampling policy.
operations.include: The solver reports or compares fit criteria such as AIC, predictive performance, calibration or generalization.
operations.exclude: The benchmark grader computes a score on submitted predictions; merely supplying test predictions or out-of-fold predictions.

operations.name: Data preparation and reconciliation
operations.outcome: Join, filter, reshape or reconcile scientific records while preserving identity and provenance.
operations.include: Reconcile identities, missingness, schemas or joins as an explicit analytical deliverable.
operations.exclude: Routine file loading, incidental filtering, or saving results.

operations.name: Scientific visualization
operations.outcome: Produce a specified scientific view with checkable data, labels, scales and graphical elements.
operations.include: Create a required figure with checkable plotted data, scales and labels.
operations.exclude: Input images; a grader inspecting a plot; optional diagnostic figures.

operations.name: Structured evidence extraction
operations.outcome: Extract specified facts or measurements with source locations, units and a finite evidence scope.
operations.include: Extract an explicit fact or measurement with a supporting source location.
operations.exclude: A citation in background; unconstrained literature synthesis; simple structured database retrieval already covered by database querying.

operations.name: Computational experiment design
operations.outcome: Select informative perturbations or queries to distinguish models within a fixed experimental budget.
operations.include: Choose observations or simulated experiments and submit the resulting design or model.
operations.exclude: Wet-lab execution; an unrestricted research plan judged for novelty or quality.

operations.name: Hypothesis testing
operations.outcome: Test an explicit null hypothesis with the correct sampling unit and report its statistic or significance.

operations.name: Effect estimation
operations.outcome: Estimate a contrast, ratio, fold change or model effect under explicit comparison and direction conventions.

operations.name: Statistical model fitting
operations.outcome: Fit a specified response model with the required design, covariates and parameter estimation.

operations.name: Descriptive statistics
operations.outcome: Calculate requested counts, proportions, distribution summaries or aggregations with explicit denominators.

operations.name: Association estimation
operations.outcome: Compute the strength and direction of dependence between matched variables; significance testing is a separate operation.

operations.name: Record filtering and ranking
operations.outcome: Select or order records under scientific eligibility, threshold or ranking rules.

operations.name: Set comparison
operations.outcome: Compute intersections, differences or membership across declared sets and identifier conventions.

operations.name: Graph and tree measurement
operations.outcome: Compute path lengths, branch summaries or other requested graph properties from supplied or reconstructed graphs.

operations.name: Sequence characterization
operations.outcome: Calculate sequence composition or site properties under explicit alphabet, ambiguity and alignment conventions.

operations.name: Sequence alignment
operations.outcome: Establish correspondence between sequences or reads and a reference under explicit alignment rules.

operations.name: Reference-based assessment
operations.outcome: Assess identity or completeness against a specified reference profile and summarize matches.

operations.name: Reference record retrieval
operations.outcome: Resolve identities and retrieve source-versioned records or annotations.

operations.name: Optimization
operations.outcome: Find an extremum of a declared objective within an explicit feasible domain.

operations.name: Uncertainty estimation
operations.outcome: Estimate sampling uncertainty, confidence intervals or related uncertainty summaries.

scientific_context.name: Transcriptomics
scientific_context.scope: Gene or transcript expression, abundance and expression-derived cell states. RNA biochemical stability alone is RNA biochemistry.

scientific_context.name: Genomic variation
scientific_context.scope: Genetic alleles, genotypes, inheritance, genetic risk and variant evidence.

scientific_context.name: Genome and sequence analysis
scientific_context.scope: Nucleotide sequence content, annotation, assembly and construct identity.

scientific_context.name: Epigenomics
scientific_context.scope: Chromatin accessibility, occupancy, contacts or DNA methylation. Gene regulation also occurs in other applications.

scientific_context.name: Proteomics
scientific_context.scope: Proteome-scale abundance, modification or interaction measurements. A single protein sequence or structure does not establish proteomics.

scientific_context.name: Metabolomics
scientific_context.scope: Metabolite identities and abundance measurements across samples.

scientific_context.name: Molecular evolution
scientific_context.scope: Evolutionary relationships, molecular conservation and divergence.

scientific_context.name: Molecular structure
scientific_context.scope: Three-dimensional biomolecular geometry, complexes and structural interactions.

scientific_context.name: Chemical biology
scientific_context.scope: Chemical entities, compound activity, affinity and chemical perturbation assays.

scientific_context.name: Functional genomics
scientific_context.scope: Gene function, regulatory relationships, pathways and gene perturbation responses.

scientific_context.name: Microbiology
scientific_context.scope: Microorganisms and microbial communities as the biological objects of analysis.

scientific_context.name: Ecology
scientific_context.scope: Populations, communities, habitats and environmental relationships.

scientific_context.name: Clinical and epidemiological analysis
scientific_context.scope: Patient-level outcomes, diagnosis, prognosis and epidemiological measurements. A drug-discovery motivation alone does not qualify.

scientific_context.name: Immunology
scientific_context.scope: Immune cells, receptors and responses as the target of the scientific question.

scientific_context.name: Biological imaging
scientific_context.scope: Biological or medical images and image-derived phenotype measurements. Chemical drawings and plots alone do not qualify.

scientific_context.name: Physiology
scientific_context.scope: Organism, organ or cell physiological function, including recorded physiological signals.

scientific_context.name: Systems biology
scientific_context.scope: Mechanistic system behavior, kinetics and interactions modeled at the system level. The word system alone is insufficient.

scientific_context.name: Protein function and biochemistry
scientific_context.scope: Protein sequence-to-function relationships and biochemical activities, including mutational scanning assays.

scientific_context.name: RNA processing and biochemistry
scientific_context.scope: RNA sequence-dependent processing, translation, stability and biochemical reactivity.

annotation_policy: A workflow connects operations, scientific decisions and output artifacts to answer a question. Differential expression and enrichment are workflow types, not general analytical operations.
An operation names required work such as model fitting, effect estimation, hypothesis testing or multiple-testing correction. A workflow label does not automatically imply its full operation list.

Record the input stage: performing differential expression from counts differs from querying a supplied result table. Do not credit background, supplied results, optional methods or benchmark-grader work.

Scientific context describes the measured objects and study setting. Its current labels are overlapping descriptors, not a domain hierarchy. Assay and study-design details remain in the source question and review notes.
Split an operation when it changes task construction, a scientific decision or an executable output. Do not decompose routine file loading or incidental arithmetic.
Prioritize missing connected workflows and their input/design variants. Operation frequencies describe shared requirements; they do not substitute for workflow diversity.
Provisional migrations retain only directly supported general operation labels. Empty or partial operation lists require review and are not evidence that no operations are needed.
A faithful executable framing must retain the scientific purpose. A deterministic proxy alone does not establish causal, clinical or experimental validity.
